steps.result: It is `20 Feb 2026`.

steps.result: It is still `14 Feb 2026`, not the value of Plan B.

ETM-8851.summary: [FE][MT] Verify pasting values into the Ramp Down/Up Date picker accepts a valid date and rejects invalid ones

steps.action: Open the `Create Plan` modal and type `Plan Scenario Paste` in Plan Name.
steps.result: The Plan Name field shows `Plan Scenario Paste`.

steps.action: Paste `15 Feb 2026 09:00` into the Start input.
steps.result: The Start part shows `15 Feb 2026 09:00`.

steps.action: Paste `31 Feb 2026 08:00` into the Start input.
steps.result: The value is not accepted and the Start part keeps `15 Feb 2026 09:00`.

steps.action: Paste `2026-02-08 08:00` into the Start input.
steps.result: The value is not accepted and the Start part keeps `15 Feb 2026 09:00`.

steps.action: Paste `25 Feb 2026 18:00` into the End input.
steps.result: The End part shows `25 Feb 2026 18:00`.

steps.action: Paste `31 Feb 2026 08:00` into the End input.
steps.result: The value is not accepted and the End part keeps `25 Feb 2026 18:00`.

steps.action: Paste `2026-02-08 08:00` into the End input.
steps.result: The value is not accepted and the End part keeps `25 Feb 2026 18:00`.

steps.action: Paste `14 Feb 2026 09:00` (earlier than Start) into the End input.
steps.result: No error message appears and the End is not earlier than the Start (the exact value is Dev pending, see the facts).

steps.action: Clear the End part.
steps.result: The End part is empty.

steps.action: Look at the Save button.
steps.result: Save is disabled.

steps.action: Click Cancel.
steps.result: The modal closes and no card `Plan Scenario Paste` appears.
